card.name: Plasma protein binding phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases about plasma protein binding, such as albumin, protein, bound and Prote(ins), mostly after 'plasma' or a percent figure. Seen in drug interaction and overdose text about dialysis or displacement.

modes.label: Plasma protein wording
modes.description: The word protein, or part of albumin or proteins, right after 'plasma' in binding statements.
modes.example: due to the 98% plasma<< protein>> binding of mycophenolic acid
